ACME INDUSTRIES LIMITED
Q1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call
July 24, 2026

MANAGEMENT:
  MR. R. IYER - MANAGING DIRECTOR & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
  MS. P. NAIR - CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER

Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Acme Industries
Limited Q1 FY27 earnings conference call. As a reminder, all participant lines
will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask
questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during
the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star and then zero
on your touchtone phone. I now hand the conference over to Mr. R. Iyer,
Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer. Thank you and over to you, sir.

Mr. R. Iyer: Thank you. Good evening everyone and thank you for joining us.
Revenue for the quarter was Rs 1,240 crore, up 14% year on year, helped by a
better product mix and steady realisations in the western region. Gross margin
for the quarter came in at 32.4%, broadly flat sequentially.

Let me turn to the outlook. We expect EBITDA margin of 15-17% in FY28 as the
new line at Ratnagiri ramps up through the year. We are working towards a net
debt position of Rs 2,000 crore by March 2028, funded entirely out of internal
accruals. Capacity will reach 4 million tonnes in FY29 once the second phase is
commissioned. We might conceivably reach 20% margin in FY30, though it is early
to put a number on that. We remain focused on disciplined execution.

Ms. P. Nair: On the balance sheet, working capital days came down to 62 from 71
a year ago. Interest cost for the quarter was Rs 41 crore. We have no material
maturities falling due before the middle of next financial year.

Moderator: Thank you. We will now begin the question-and-answer session. The
first question is from the line of A. Krishnan from an institutional brokerage.
Please go ahead.

A. Krishnan: Thank you for taking my question. Could you talk about the capex
plan for the next two years, and whether the Ratnagiri phase two is included in
that number?

Mr. R. Iyer: Yes. We are targeting capex of Rs 900 crore for FY28, and that
number includes phase two at Ratnagiri. Beyond that we have not committed to
anything further. Volume growth should be in the high single digits for the
full year, assuming the monsoon is normal. We remain focused on disciplined
execution.

A. Krishnan: Understood. And on exports?

Mr. R. Iyer: Exports were 11% of revenue this quarter. We are not guiding on
that line separately at this stage.

Moderator: Thank you. As there are no further questions, I now hand the
conference over to management for closing comments.

Mr. R. Iyer: Thank you all for joining. We look forward to speaking with you
again next quarter.

Moderator: Thank you. On behalf of Acme Industries Limited, that concludes this
conference. Thank you for joining us and you may now disconnect your lines.
